items.title: Partner With Us
body: We are constantly looking for partners to work with. Visit our Projects page and, if you are interested, send us an email. Let's get a conversation about how to implement the partnership.

items.title: Donate
body: We are constantly looking for donations in cash for the implementation of projects that are beneficial to independent creatives, and in-kind support in the form of studio equipment for our Creative Hub and Connected Studios.

If you are interested, scan the QR code to access our banking information, then send us an email with the wiring information. We will acknowledge receipt and chat further on how to acknowledge the donation, for example by listing the donor as a supporter on our website.

items.title: Buy Merch
body: Visit our online stores at the following links, and shop to support us. Thanks in advance.

items.title: Publish with Us
body: Are you an independent artist or independent record label looking for a publisher? Send us a motivation or application letter and mention "Request for Publishing service". Also send links to your online music, especially Spotify.

If what you are doing has some potential, you will receive a draft publishing contract for review. We will exchange and negotiate until both parties agree and sign. You can let your lawyer advise you on the terms.

items.title: Link Us to Opportunities
body: You can support us by sharing links to current opportunities: funding, travel grants, trainings, scholarships, workshops, sync licensing submissions, seminars, venture capital and other investment opportunities.
items.subject: Opportunity to share

items.title: Join Us
body: As an aspiring start-up, we are looking forward to grow. You can join us as a shareholder, venture capitalist (or venture capitalist hunter), board member, executive, or in junior (entry) roles, to build a strong team and formalize the relationship.
All roles are pro bono until the company has a positive cash flow. You must have a main job.
items.subject: Join Maculture Digitals

items.title: Train Us
body: Are you a training institution? Give us training in the domains of the digital economy, entrepreneurship, sound engineering and more. Let's get a conversation about how to implement the partnership.
